runes.overview: Runes provide stat bonuses, starting skills and special passives. They equip to a fixed set of slots arranged around the active hero.

equip_slots.new_player_gating: Etched Rune slots #2 and #3 are locked until the player reaches certain rune-level thresholds. Slot #1 is available from the start.
equip_slots.loadouts: The Runes screen shares the same 8 loadouts as Gear, via a dropdown at top right.

category_roles.ability_runes: Grant Starting Skills - active in-run abilities (procs and summoned units). Without them the hero has only main-weapon attacks plus their unique kit.
category_roles.enhancement_runes: Amplify a specific theme. They do not grant starting skills; they reshape how a theme behaves once active. Higher base stats than Ability Runes (ATK PWR +950 / +1,200 vs +50 on a comparable Ability Rune).
category_roles.blessing_runes: Passive run-modifiers (luck, dodge, conversion, revive). They shift probabilities, enable safety nets or convert stats. With only 2 slots this is one of the highest-leverage build decisions.
category_roles.etched_runes: High-power category amplifiers that lock in build identity. Substantially higher base stats (e.g. ATK PWR +1,200 vs +50 on a comparable Ability Rune). They multiply what your Ability Runes produce rather than granting Starting Skills.

themes.count: 7 themes: Circle, Main Weapon, Sword Strike, Meteor, Elemental, Plant, Sprite.
themes.scope: All Ability, Enhancement and Etched Runes fall into one of the 7 themes. Blessing Runes sit outside this categorization.
themes.why_it_matters: Promised Ruins targets by theme; Etched Runes amplify by theme (a Sprite Etched Rune only multiplies Sprite-themed runes); strategic builds align all 4 Ability + 4 Enhancement + 3 Etched runes around 1-3 themes.
themes.group_split_note: The Group A / Group B split of the 7 themes exists only as the Promised Ruins selection mechanic. Outside that screen the themes are flat.

rarity_ladder.order: Common, Fine, Rare, Epic, Epic +1, Epic +2, Legendary, Legendary +1, Legendary +2, Legendary +3, Mythic (max).
rarity_ladder.differs_from_gear: Runes cap at Mythic - no Chaotic tier and no Mythic + variants, unlike gear.
rarity_ladder.f2p_outlook: Mythic runes are realistically reachable for F2P but take a long time accumulating duplicates from Hunt drops, Rune Ruins, Promised Ruins and free chests. Legendary +3 on key runes is a comfortable mid-term F2P goal; Mythic is long-term.

stat_unlock_mechanics.one_stat_per_tier: Each named rarity tier unlocks one new stat line, shown on the detail screen as a colour-dotted row.
stat_unlock_mechanics.dot_tiers: Dots represent only the 6 named tiers: Common, Fine, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic. A lock icon means not yet unlocked.
stat_unlock_mechanics.plus_variants: Epic +1/+2 and Legendary +1/+2/+3 sit between the named tiers. On Ability, Enhancement and Blessing Runes they add no new rows - they amplify existing effect values and bump the cumulative primary stat.
stat_unlock_mechanics.primary_stat_row: The top row shows the cumulative primary stat (knife icon = ATK PWR, heart icon = Max HP), which scales through every tier including the + variants and Mythic.
stat_unlock_mechanics.enchantment_unlock_position: The Enchantment slot unlocks at Epic +2, between the Epic and Legendary dots, so it is not a dot row; it appears as a separate section at the bottom of the rune detail screen.
stat_unlock_mechanics.locked_row_reading: Lock colour indicates the tier band: a yellow lock is the Legendary band (L, L+1, L+2, L+3 - 4 rows, top-to-bottom in that order), a red lock is Mythic (1 row). Locked text stays readable.

unlock_counts_by_category.ability_runes: 6 unlocks total, one per named tier. + variants only bump the cumulative primary stat.
unlock_counts_by_category.enhancement_runes: 6 unlocks total, same as Ability. + variants are stat-value bumps only.
unlock_counts_by_category.blessing_runes: 4 unlocks total (Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic). Common and Fine are absorbed into the cumulative ATK PWR + Max HP shown at the top of the detail screen.
unlock_counts_by_category.etched_runes: Up to 9 unlocks total - the 6 named tiers plus additional buff lines at Legendary +1, +2 and +3. Unique to Etched Runes; these L+ variants meaningfully grow the rune's kit, not just its numbers.
unlock_counts_by_category.mythic_is_terminal: Mythic is the top tier: final unlock, max stat values, no further upgrades.

runes.blessing_rune_primary_stats: Blessing Runes show two primary stats. At Legendary +2 each displays roughly ATK PWR +570 and Max HP +2,280 as baseline cumulative stats.

enchantment_system.applies_to: Ability, Enhancement and Blessing Runes only. Etched Runes do NOT have an Enchantment slot - they only have an Equip button.
enchantment_system.unlock: Unlocked at Epic +2 per rune (each rune individually must reach Epic +2), not account-wide.
enchantment_system.archive: Each rune has an Enchantment Archive - a pool of possible Enchantment Stats organised into categories specific to the rune type.
enchantment_system.one_at_a_time: Only ONE Enchantment can be equipped at a time per rune.
enchantment_system.how_to_change: Use the Enchant button on a rune to open the Enchantizer screen and swap which Enchantment Stat is active.
enchantment_system.placeholder_text: Until a selection is made after the Epic +2 unlock, the line displays the placeholder 'Unlocks Rune Enchantment'.
enchantment_system.progression_bar: A progression bar at the bottom of the Enchantizer (observed at 21/100) tracks toward additional Archive entries.
enchantment_system.quality_range: Each Archive entry has its own rarity, Common through Mythic, determined by the pull. The Specialized category is always Legendary or Mythic, never lower.
enchantment_system.archive_rule: In-game Rule 3: the affix archive stores unlocked affix types of the highest quality. They can be freely switched in unlocked rune slots and saved as different presets.
enchantment_system.archive_keeps_best: The Archive remembers only the highest-quality version of each affix ever pulled. A later Mythic replaces an earlier Legendary of the same affix.
enchantment_system.free_switching: Once an affix is in the Archive you can freely switch among entries with no re-rolling.
enchantment_system.presets: Presets can be saved per rune slot, e.g. one for boss fights and one for crowd clear.
enchantment_system.obtained_label: The 'Obtained' label next to an affix in the Rules popup means that affix is already in your Archive.

enchantment_categories.blessing_runes: 9 categories: ATK PWR; Max HP; Reduced Circle DMG taken; Reduced Sword Strike DMG taken; Reduced Sprite DMG taken; Reduced Main Weapon DMG taken; Reduced Meteor DMG taken; Reduced Elemental DMG taken; Specialized. Categories 1-8 roll Common to Mythic; Specialized always rolls Legendary or Mythic and is rune-specific.
enchantment_categories.enhancement_runes: 7 categories: ATK PWR; [Theme] DMG (varies by rune theme); Boss DMG; More damage VS minions; [Theme] CRIT Rate; CRIT DMG; Specialized. Categories 1-6 roll Common to Mythic; Specialized always rolls Legendary or Mythic.
enchantment_categories.ability_runes: 7 categories: Max HP; Elemental DMG; Boss DMG REDUC; Minion DMG REDUC; Elemental CRIT DMG; CRIT DMG REDUC; Specialized. Categories 1-6 roll Common to Mythic; Specialized always rolls Legendary or Mythic.
enchantment_categories.ability_vs_enhancement: Ability Rune enchantments skew defensive and elemental (Max HP, REDUC stats); Enhancement skews offensive (ATK PWR, DMG bumps). Both have 7 categories with Specialized as the 7th.
enchantment_categories.open_question: Source flags as unverified whether 'Elemental DMG' and 'Elemental CRIT DMG' on Ability Runes are literal or theme-flexible (e.g. whether Plant Summon shows 'Plant DMG' instead).
enchantment_categories.specialized_strategy: Specialized is the only Blessing enchantment guaranteed Legendary+ and is uniquely tailored to that rune, so a Mythic Specialized roll is generally the strongest enchantment outcome.
enchantment_categories.specialized_coverage: Every Ability, Enhancement and Blessing Rune has its own unique Mythic Specialized Enchantment. The source documents all 7 Blessing ones and 2 of 13 Enhancement ones (Sharp Arrow, Frostshock Seal); the remaining 11 Enhancement and all 13 Ability Specialized enchantments are undocumented.

enchantizer_currencies.enchantium: Standard Enchantizer pull currency (green triangle with arrowhead icon).
enchantizer_currencies.advanced_enchantium: Advanced Enchantizer pull currency (pink circle with arrowhead icon). Much rarer than standard Enchantium.
enchantizer_currencies.gems: The standard top-bar gem currency. Convertible into Enchantium, but the enchanting cost itself is paid in Enchantium - gems and Enchantium are different currencies.
enchantizer_currencies.gem_to_enchantium_rate: The gem cost per Enchantium batch escalates with attempts made that day: 300 gems/attempt for the 21st-30th purchase, 400 gems/attempt for the 31st-40th, with further escalation likely above.
enchantizer_currencies.daily_reset: The gem cost ladder resets daily, so heavy converters should spread purchases across days rather than burning them in one sitting.

standard_enchantizer.mechanic: Each attempt rolls 3 random Enchantments from the rune's eligible affix pool, shown in a slot-machine-style 3-row UI. You choose one to equip or skip and re-roll.
standard_enchantizer.skip_toggle: When the Skip toggle is on, the machine auto-rolls past Common/Fine/Rare results.
standard_enchantizer.auto_enchant: Holding the Enchant button repeats pulls automatically and pauses on any Legendary or Mythic result (in-game Rule 2).
standard_enchantizer.anti_dup_rule: When enchanting runes of the same type, identical Mythic affixes will not be drawn - Mythic dupes are filtered.
standard_enchantizer.practical_rate: Roughly 1 in 400 standard pulls is Mythic.
standard_enchantizer.mythic_specialized_rate: Pulling a Mythic Specialized via the Standard Enchantizer is roughly 1 in 1,667 pulls.

advanced_enchantizer.pity_counter: A 'Get Mythic affix in N draws' counter guarantees a Mythic affix within a rolling pity window (observed at 3 draws).
advanced_enchantizer.mechanic: Same 3-row slot machine, Skip toggle and auto-enchant rules as the standard Enchantizer, with dramatically better odds.

drop_rates.epic: ~70% cumulative (source flags exact % as needing verification)

advanced_enchantizer.practical_rate: Roughly 1 in 9 Advanced pulls is Mythic, versus 1 in 400 standard.
advanced_enchantizer.earning_advanced_enchantium: 1 Advanced Enchantium per 100 standard Enchant pulls - the 21/100 counter at the bottom of the standard Enchantizer tracks this. That is 100,000 Enchantium spent per 1 Advanced Enchantium earned.
advanced_enchantizer.direct_purchase: Advanced Enchantium can also be bought directly; store details undocumented in source.
advanced_enchantizer.strategic_note: The Advanced Enchantizer's 11% Mythic rate plus its pity counter is what makes endgame Enchantments feasible. F2P accumulate Advanced Enchantium slowly.

rune_workshop.purpose: Fuse/merge owned runes to produce a single higher-rarity rune.
rune_workshop.warehouse: The Warehouse view shows all available (non-equipped) runes.
rune_workshop.quick_fuse: Quick Fuse auto-selects optimal fusion candidates.
rune_workshop.result: The Fusion successful popup shows the result rune name, new rarity, a stat preview (old to new) and any newly unlocked stat lines.
rune_workshop.equipped_excluded: Equipped runes are excluded from fusion and show an 'Equipped' overlay.

rune_ruins.dig_x1: Costs 1 Ruin Shovel, or falls back to Gems.
rune_ruins.auto_dig: Hold down to auto-dig for batch digs.
rune_ruins.drop_rate_example: Rusty Chest, excluding the minimum guarantee: overall rate 28.80% at the rune tier - 15 individual runes at 1.11% each, then more at 0.31% / 0.30% / 0.15% for rarer items. Higher-tier chests follow the same structure with higher rarity floors.

promised_ruins.purpose: Same chest framework as Rune Ruins but category-targeted.
promised_ruins.selection_rule: You pick ONE category from EACH of the two groups (not 'or'), so every dig is guaranteed to draw from both selections.
promised_ruins.group_a: Pick one of: Circle, Main Weapon, Sword Strike.
promised_ruins.group_b: Pick one of: Meteor, Elemental, Plant, Sprite.
promised_ruins.when_to_use: Use Promised Ruins when building toward two specific themes; use Rune Ruins when fishing broadly.

rune_packs.daily_special_pack: Refreshes every 24h. 6 packs ranging from 499 Aurocite up to $49.99 USD, all flagged '400% Value'.
rune_packs.weekly_special_pack: Refreshes weekly, with additional packs at higher price points.
rune_packs.typical_contents: Gems, gold, ruin shovels, relic shovels, runes directly, and rune-related upgrade materials.

sources_summary.hunt: Best for bulk passive runes. Cost: free / energy / ad.
sources_summary.rune_ruins: Best for random rune fishing. Cost: Ruin Shovels or Gems.
sources_summary.promised_ruins: Best for targeted theme runes. Cost: Relic Shovels or Gems (300+).
sources_summary.packs: Paid bundles with mixed contents. Cost: Aurocite or USD.
sources_summary.rune_workshop: Upgrades rarity rather than granting new runes. Cost: existing duplicate runes.

build_patterns.principle: You equip 4 Ability + 4 Enhancement runes simultaneously. Ability Runes give the building blocks (starting skills, summons, procs); Enhancement Runes amplify and reshape how those skills behave. Match Etched Runes to your equipped Ability Runes.
build_patterns.sprite_build: 2x Sprite Ability (Melee Sprite, Healing Sprite) + 2x Sprite Enhancement (Sprite Multishot, Sprite Link) + Sprite Etched (Sprite Assist, Sprite's Awe).
build_patterns.circle_build: 2x Circle Ability (Circle, Ring of Agony) + 2x Circle Enhancement (Sawblade Circle, Spin SPD Up) + Circle Etched (Pulsing Orb, Orbital Orb).
build_patterns.plant_build: Plant Summon + Equinox Bloom + Rootguard + Vine Bind + Life Surge.
build_patterns.meteor_build: Star of Time + Star of Fury + Potion Magnet + Giant Meteor + Meteor Split / Potion Spring.
build_patterns.etched_slots_declare_identity: With only 3 Etched slots, your Etched Runes essentially declare which 3 categories the build leans on. Multi-category builds spread them thinner.

runes._coverage: Source catalogues 13 Ability, 13 Enhancement, 7 Blessing and 13 Etched Runes, and notes more Etched Runes likely exist beyond those documented.
